يستقدموا (form X)
# يَسْتَقْدِمُوا (yastaqdimū) /jas.taq.di.muː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْدَمَ (istaqdama)
# يُسْتَقْدَمُوا (yustaqdamū) /jus.taq.da.muː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْدَمَ (istaqdama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
